title: Armoured Cohort vs Magdeburg Warhost
lede:
Magdeburg Warhost won 36-10 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, scoring the round's 10 VP cap in the first round and the last.

Its Corporaider Squads and Black Huskarls stood on all three objectives before the Armoured Cohort reached any, then charged the Legionnaire Squads one by one: the Cohort lost six units and 162 RP to the Warhost's 28.
result_line: Magdeburg Warhost win 36-10 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and the 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Armoured Cohort lined up in front of its HQ at (7,13): Chiron Battle Tank 2 at (3,12) and Chiron Battle Tank 1 at (11,12) on the wings, Legionnaire Squad 2 at (4,12), Equites Igniferi at (6,13), the Augur with the Praetorian Fireteam at (8,12), the Centurion with Legionnaire Squad 1 at (9,12) and Legionnaire Squad 3 at (10,12). Magdeburg Warhost set up on row 2 in front of its HQ at (7,1): Otto of Saxony with Odin's Einherjar at (3,2), Black Huskarls (5,2), Corporaider Squad 2 (6,2), Corporaider Squad 3 (8,2), Grey Huskarls (9,2), the Runesmith (10,2) and Corporaider Squad 1 (11,2). Both armies spread evenly across the line; the difference was speed, the Warhost's squads reaching row 6 and 7 in one Movement Phase. The Warhost won the Roll Off for Priority.

1.title: The Warhost on all three objectives

feed.text: Primaries revealed: BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Cohort, STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION for the Warhost. Secondaries kept: BAR THE GATES and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET, for which the Cohort named the right objective at (13,7). The Cohort chose Tactica Mercurii; the Warhost spent 2 CP on Double Time for Corporaider Squad 2.

The Warhost moved first and onto every objective: Corporaider Squad 2 to 2,6 on the left, Black Huskarls to 7,7 and Corporaider Squad 3 to 7,6 on the centre, Corporaider Squad 1 to 12,7 on the right. The Cohort advanced to rows 8 to 10, Equites Igniferi to 2,10 and Legionnaire Squad 3 to 9,8, with no unit in an Objective Area.
One shot was fired: Grey Huskarls hit Legionnaire Squad 3 for 1 and PARALYZED it, through the Cohort's Go to Ground (1 CP). Every other unit on the table had no legal action.

The Warhost scored all three objectives on OC 15, 10 and 10 to 0 (7 VP) and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET for 3, the round's 10 VP. BAR THE GATES completed for the Cohort, +2, and took its Pietas to Tier II. 2-10.
The Warhost spent 2 CP on Double Time for the Runesmith; the Cohort held its 3. Secondaries kept: SECURE THE FLANKS and DEEP REACH.

Equites Igniferi charged Corporaider Squad 2 on the left (Crushing Impact, 3 HP), and the Corporaiders broke away in disorder to 2,3. Legionnaire Squad 3 walked from 9,8 to 12,9, beside Corporaider Squad 1, under another Go to Ground (1 CP), and Corporaider Squad 1 charged it. Odin's Einherjar with Otto of Saxony charged the Centurion's and the Augur's squads at 6,8; both failed their Fall Back tests and broke away in disorder, a model each, and Svinfylking moved Corporaider Squad 3 to 8,7. Corporaider Squad 3 then charged Legionnaire Squad 2 at 5,5, and Black Huskarls charged Legionnaire Squad 1 and Chiron Battle Tank 2 at 4,10 and 5,10.

Chiron Battle Tank 1 fired its Overpressure Shell and hit Grey Huskarls for 2. Corporaider Squad 1 destroyed Legionnaire Squad 3 (9 damage). Legionnaire Squad 2 attacked Corporaider Squad 3 for 2 and took 6 back. Black Huskarls destroyed Legionnaire Squad 1 (8) and hit the Centurion for 4; the Centurion's counterattack took 4 off them. The Runesmith spent 2 Loots to Inscribe Rune of Protection on Corporaider Squad 3, and the Augur cast Sacrificium for 2 Mana the Cohort never used. The kills paid the Warhost 19 Loots this round.
The Cohort took the left on OC 10 vs 0 (2 VP), and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for taking it from the Warhost. The Warhost held the centre (OC 20 vs 0) and the right, 5 VP, and DEEP REACH paid 3. 7-18.

3.title: Otto takes Legionnaire Squad 2, the guns take Chiron 1

feed.text: The Cohort spent all 4 CP on Secure Objective for Equites Igniferi, which bought nothing. Otto of Saxony's Mint Privilege turned 3 Loots into 2 CP. Legionnaire Squad 2 failed Morale and was SUPPRESSED. Secondaries kept: FORWARD PRESENCE and PROBING STRIKE.

Legionnaire Squad 2 broke away from Corporaider Squad 3 to 6,3, two squares from the Warhost's HQ. Black Huskarls failed their Fall Back test against the Centurion and Chiron Battle Tank 2 and broke away in disorder to 4,6. Odin's Einherjar charged Legionnaire Squad 2 from 7,4, and Svinfylking and a charge put Corporaider Squad 3 at 2,7 against Equites Igniferi, the Praetorian Fireteam and the Augur. Chiron Battle Tank 1 drove to 12,6, into the right objective's area.

Otto of Saxony used Mining Baron (+1 AP) and destroyed Legionnaire Squad 2. The Praetorian Fireteam attacked Corporaider Squad 3 and lost 2 to the counterattack; Equites Igniferi did 1. The Runesmith inscribed Rune of Protection on Grey Huskarls. Corporaider Squad 1 shot Chiron Battle Tank 1 for 6 and Grey Huskarls destroyed it with 4 more. The Centurion's fire left Grey Huskarls BURNED on 1 HP.

The Cohort kept the left on OC 15 vs 8 (2 VP). The Warhost held the centre with Grey Huskarls and the Runesmith (OC 2 vs 0) and the right, 5 VP, and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid 3: the Cohort's Primary scored nothing and Chiron Battle Tank 1 died in an Objective Area. 9-26.

4.title: The Augur's squad falls and the Warhost passes 30

feed.text: The Cohort switched to Tactica Martis and spent 2 CP on Rally Cry for the Centurion. Mint Privilege gave Otto's side 2 more CP, and the Warhost spent 4 on Secure Objective for Corporaider Squad 3 on the left and 2 on Rally Cry for Black Huskarls. Grey Huskarls failed Morale. Secondaries kept: LAST STAND and KING OF THE HILL.

Odin's Einherjar and Otto walked onto the centre at 6,6. Corporaider Squad 2 charged the Praetorian Fireteam, the Augur and Chiron Battle Tank 2 at 3,7; Black Huskarls charged Chiron Battle Tank 2 at 5,8. The Centurion walked away to 10,10.

Chiron Battle Tank 2's Overpressure Shell at 6,6 did nothing against the Einherjar's Go to Ground (1 CP). Corporaider Squad 3 put 3 into the Praetorian Fireteam and Equites Igniferi 2 into Corporaider Squad 3. Corporaider Squad 2 then destroyed the last Praetorian and the Augur. Black Huskarls took Chiron Battle Tank 2 to 2 HP. Grey Huskarls shot the Cohort's HQ for 3, and BURNED destroyed them at the end of the phase. The Centurion's Tactical Supremacy changed nothing. PROBING STRIKE completed, +2.

The Warhost took all three objectives, the left on OC 6 vs 5 with the Secure Objective deciding it: 7 VP, STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 1 for the Augur's death in an Objective Area, the round's 10 VP. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Cohort 1 for Equites Igniferi still in the left's area. 10-36, the Warhost past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Magdeburg Warhost scored 24 of its 36 VP from objectives: all three in Rounds 1 and 4, the centre and right in Rounds 2 and 3. Three secondaries paid 8 (TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 3, DEEP REACH 3, PROBING STRIKE 2) and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 4. The Armoured Cohort scored 10: the left objective in Rounds 2 and 3 (4), BREAK THEIR HOLD 4 (3 for taking the left, 1 for standing in it) and BAR THE GATES 2. It never scored the centre or the right.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Corporaider Squad 1 (22 RP) was the battle's scorer: it stood on the right objective all four rounds, all 8 of its objective VP hinged on it, it completed TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET and it destroyed Legionnaire Squad 3, 13.4 VP and 60.9 per 100 RP. Black Huskarls did the most damage, 20, and destroyed Legionnaire Squad 1 with the Centurion beside it. Corporaider Squad 2 took the two Round 4 kills that ended the Augur's squad. The kills paid the Warhost Loots, 19 in Round 2 alone, which bought two Rune of Protection inscriptions (4 Loots) and 4 CP through Otto of Saxony's Mint Privilege (6 Loots).

For the Cohort, Equites Igniferi held the left in Rounds 2 and 3 and scored 3.7 VP, its only unit above 1. The Centurion was its best gun, 8 damage, and its BURNED finished Grey Huskarls for the Cohort's one kill. The two Chiron Battle Tanks (80 RP) did 2 damage between them: both Overpressure Shells were spent, one for 2 HP and one for nothing.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Cohort could not do

It never contested the centre or the right. The Warhost reached all three objectives in Round 1, and every Cohort unit that came close was charged before it could shoot: Legionnaire Squad 3 on the right, Legionnaire Squad 1 and 2 around the centre, the Praetorian Fireteam on the left. Its Legionnaire Squads, BS 3+ now, fired once in four rounds, an Overwatch shot from Legionnaire Squad 1. FORWARD PRESENCE (a unit within 3 squares of the enemy HQ) and LAST STAND never scored, and SECURE THE FLANKS expired.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 2, Legionnaire Squad 3: walked from 9,8, two squares from the centre, to 12,9 beside Corporaider Squad 1 but outside the right objective's area, and was charged and destroyed, after 2 CP of Go to Ground had been spent on it in Rounds 1 and 2.
  • Round 3, Secure Objective: the Cohort's whole 4 CP on Equites Igniferi, which held the left 10 vs 8 without it. The record prices it at nothing.
  • Round 3, Legionnaire Squad 2: fell back to 6,3, inside FORWARD PRESENCE's 3 squares of the Warhost HQ, and Otto of Saxony destroyed it there in the Action Phase before the card could score.
  • Round 4, the Centurion walked from 7,10 to 10,10, away from every objective, in the round the Warhost passed 30.
  • On the Warhost's side, Odin's Einherjar (43 RP) took no action in four rounds (its best option twice was Plunder, below the AI's threshold), and Otto of Saxony made one attack. The army won without its most expensive pair fighting.

The army decided this more than the AI: the Warhost's squads are faster, cheap enough to cover three objectives, and win the charge. The Cohort's AI made it worse by feeding units into charges one at a time.

Against the first playing

The first playing also went to Magdeburg Warhost in Round 4, 37-9. The two records share the shape: the Warhost on all three objectives from Round 1 and the Cohort's Legionnaire Squads charged down. This time the Cohort lost six units and 162 RP (95 in the first playing) and the Warhost lost one, Grey Huskarls, where it had lost none. The 10 VP round cap did not bite, but the Warhost hit it exactly twice; in the first playing it scored 11 in Rounds 2 and 4. The cheaper Otto of Saxony (60 RP, was 70) paid for the 5 RP added to Odin's Einherjar and to Black Huskarls, and Black Huskarls was the top damage dealer in both.

closing: The Warhost won the battle in its first Movement Phase: three objectives held before the Cohort arrived, and charges that met each Cohort unit as it came. Corporaider Squad 1, 22 RP, stood on the right objective for the whole battle and scored more than the entire Cohort.
